purpose: Teach: アラスカ/アインシュタイン/トライアル/電話機/ブーツ/石鹸/キャスター/セレクト

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがアラスカ航路の話してらしたぞ
lines.en: You know, Gran, when your father was young, he used to talk about sailing the Alaska routes.
lines.style: Soft, nostalgic opening. Lean into the memory with quiet affection. Measured pace. Eyes slightly distant, as if seeing the past. No performance—just remembering out loud.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、アインシュタインの伝記を読まれたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, dear—and your grandfather, he read that biography of Einstein, didn't he?
lines.style: Warm interjection, gently steering back to shared time. Affectionate, almost playful. A light touch on 「read」. She's not correcting him, just... remembering alongside.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、新製品のトライアルを村でされたぞ
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, they tested a brand-new product right here in the village.
lines.style: Another memory surfaces—quieter now, more introspective. Slight pause before the detail. Slow, deliberate. The voice of someone turning something over in his mind.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、回転式の電話機をお使いになったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: That's right—and you were always so careful when you'd use that rotary telephone, weren't you?
lines.style: Gentle affirmation with tender humor underneath. She's tracking his memories, meeting him there. Warm breath on the words. A knowing smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがブーツを履いて出かけられたぞ
lines.en: Gran, in those early days, your father would put on his boots and head out.
lines.style: The rhythm deepens—more stillness between thoughts. Voice slightly thinner, as if the memory costs something. A tender specificity in 「boots.」 No rush.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、自家製の石鹸を好まれたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: You were always so thoughtful about picking out gifts, weren't you, dear?
lines.style: She's weaving their life together now. Warm, slightly distant herself. A soft reassurance in her tone—I remember too. Eyes crinkle. Breath easy.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、ラジオのキャスターの声に憧れたぞ
lines.en: Gran, when I was a boy, I was fascinated by the voice of a radio announcer.
lines.style: The final memory—the most vulnerable. Quieter still. A half-smile in the voice, embarrassed and honest at once. Slow fade on 「fascinated.」 Almost confessional.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、お土産をセレクトされる時は丁寧だったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And you were always so careful and deliberate whenever you chose something for someone, weren't you?
lines.style: Close now. Her voice holds both of them. Tender, affirming. She's saying: I see you. I remember who you are. Breath warm. Almost a whisper, but full.
